title: Server Invoke Request
description: Request body for POST /api/v1/invoke (canonical, per simulations/SCHEMA.md).

step.description: ID of the current step inside the action.

progress.description: Progress: scalar percent or structured object (batched / UI).

context.description: Execution context echoed from previous server response. System-managed, free-form.

action.description: Optional action ID the client records for the current step.

result.description: Client result for the previous execute step (action-key shape or form result).

choice.description: ID selected from execute.form.choices (e.g. fix-vue-imports, auto-ai, task-decomposition).

action.description: Legacy field for selected action. New flows should prefer result.choice.

message.description: Free text message from user (execute.form.textarea → result.message).
Top-level user text (SDK/invoke.service); same role as result.message for some clients.

code_blocks.description: File attachments for invoke (snake_case API field).

oneOf.description: First request: only task is sent.
Subsequent requests: context (plus optional result) with execution state.
